description: Initial raw Zomato Bangalore listing dataset with multi-zone listing duplicates.
Removed duplicate listings for identical restaurant entities listed across multiple Bangalore search zones.
Extracted numeric ratings out of 5.0 and removed unrated outlets marked as 'NEW' or '-'.
Cleaned comma thousand-separators and parsed cost for two into numeric values in INR.
Removed records missing location, cuisines, restaurant category, or with zero cost.
Binary encoded services, grouped rare types into 'Other', computed log(cost) & log(votes), and established highly_rated target (>= 4.0).
